summary: This PR does two things, both verified against the actual live server state rather than taken on faith: (1) it pulls scripts/worker-entrypoint.sh and scripts/doc-worker-entrypoint.sh into the claude-control repo for the first time (they previously existed only on the live server, per SCRIPTS_LIVE_VS_REPO_DRIFT_AUDIT_2026-07-25.yaml, which explains why the diff shows them as brand-new files despite extensive dated history in their own comments), and (2) it adds the crontab_unauthorized_change reason to the pre-flight hard-stop list in both entrypoints. I diffed the branch's copies against the actual /opt/veridian/scripts/*.sh files currently deployed on the server and confirmed the only differences are exactly the claimed fix (the new hard-stop condition plus PREFLIGHT-GUARD-BLOCK marker comments for test extraction) -- no unrelated drift or unintended changes were smuggled in. I also confirmed preflight-guard.py genuinely emits reason="crontab_unauthorized_change" (line 226, check_crontab_unauthorized_change), so the fix targets a real code path, and I ran the new regression test (tests/preflight_guard_hardstop_test.sh) directly, which passes and correctly distinguishes the new hard-stop case from a genuinely transient one (disk_low). The change is additive/low-blast-radius (new files, a bug-fix conditional, a test), does not touch .github/workflows/**, migrations, schema, auth, or payment/billing paths, so tier1 classification is correct.
issues: Minor, non-blocking: doc-worker-entrypoint.sh's header comment still describes worker-entrypoint.sh as force-routing through the GLM-5.2/OpenRouter proxy, but worker-entrypoint.sh's own code (and header) shows it now uses the real Claude Max subscription (GLM proxy decommissioned 2026-07-18/07-23 per SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md). This is a stale comment carried over from the live file, not something this diff introduces, but worth a follow-up doc cleanup.
